title: Pip and the Clockwork Owl
logline: A curious boy and a mechanical bird work together in a secret library to catch a magical key.

scenes.title: The Hidden Door
scenes.narrative_text: On a rainy afternoon, Pip pulled back a dusty velvet curtain in his grandfather’s house. Behind it stood a spiral staircase winding upward. Curiosity sparked in his amber eyes. Pip climbed the wooden steps and pushed open a heavy oak door, revealing the warm, forgotten Secret Attic Library.

scenes.title: A Brass Friend
scenes.narrative_text: Inside the library, leather-bound books stacked as high as trees. Atop a mahogany desk sat a tiny metallic bird. With a soft chime and clicking gears, the Clockwork Owl stretched his brass wings. Barnaby opened his glowing sapphire eyes, turned his head, and gave Pip a friendly hoot.

scenes.title: The Floating Key
scenes.narrative_text: Barnaby fluttered his wings and pointed his brass beak upward. High near the vaulted rafters hovered a shimmering object. It was a Floating Key, bobbing in the air like a tiny golden feather. Below it stood a grand locked chest covered in constellation maps, waiting to be opened.

scenes.title: Teamwork in the Air
scenes.narrative_text: The key was too high for Pip to reach. Barnaby spun his silver gears and took flight! Whispering past glowing lamps, the clockwork bird fluttered around the Floating Key. With gentle taps of his brass wings, Barnaby guided the drifting key downward into Pip’s waiting hands.

scenes.title: Starlight Stories
scenes.narrative_text: Pip inserted the golden key into the chest's lock. Click! The lid popped open, releasing hundreds of glittering story-stars that danced around the library. Sitting side by side on a cozy rug, Pip and Barnaby read magical tales beneath a ceiling full of glowing constellations.
